subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and what storage, validation, auth, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The request crosses a new file-upload and workspace-write boundary, so automation should not choose the security model or source-of-truth behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves existing avatar read protections.

options.title: Keep browser-local/manual paths
options.body: Continue supporting Quick Settings local overrides plus CLI/manual `IDENTITY.md` or config identity edits, avoiding a new server-side upload surface.

options.title: Defer core upload
options.body: Leave this open or close later only if maintainers decide avatar upload belongs in a broader identity-management redesign rather than current Control UI scope.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves existing avatar read protections.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original avatar support and are the best available routing owner for the product/security boundary choice.
